# cmd/constitution-lint/org-denylist.txt
# One literal token per line, matched case-sensitively as a WHOLE WORD
# (word-boundary regex around the regex-quoted token — not bare substring:
# short tokens like the 3-character codename below would otherwise match
# inside unrelated identifiers, hashes, and .jsonl cassette payloads and
# fail the gate spuriously). # comments and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Seeded from a historical scrub already recorded in this repo
# (docs/plans/2026-07-uplift.md, Wave 0, line ~183: "org-agnostic doc scrub
# (s1m/Throughline/Muster/Testament names out)").
#
# Verified against the live tree (2026-07-16, at the time this check was
# introduced): s1m, Muster, and Testament genuinely appear NOWHERE else in
# the tracked tree — a clean regression guard against reappearance.
#
# "Throughline" is DELIBERATELY OMITTED from this list despite being named
# in that same historical sentence. It is the real, disclosed, currently-in-
# -use name of one of the kit's three actual downstream consumers (alongside
# sextant and growing-gardens-bi) — see TRACKING.md (dozens of legitimate
# hits), CHANGELOG.md, docs/plans/handoff-h3-throughline.md,
# docs/upgrades/throughline-v0.2-adoption*.md, and several
# foundations/*/types.go doc comments describing its provenance invariants
# (e.g. foundations/evidence/evidence-span/types.go). Denylisting it would
# fail this check against dozens of current, legitimate files for no real
# leak — exactly the "waiver file containing half the tree" theater trap
# the H8 handoff plan warns against. If a future decision anonymizes
# Throughline's name from public-facing material, add it back then with
# that rationale, not this one.
#
# NOTE: the lowercase sibling-repo names sextant, throughline, and
# growing-gardens-bi are NOT here either — they are required architecture
# (task downstream-check's three real consumers), used intentionally and
# correctly throughout Taskfile.yml/TRACKING.md/README.md. This denylist
# targets the specific historical coded/capitalized tokens only.
s1m
Muster
Testament
